# `foxglove datasets edit`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](datasets.md)

```text
Edit a dataset's name or description

Usage: foxglove datasets edit [OPTIONS] <DATASET_ID>

Arguments:
  <DATASET_ID>


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --description <DESCRIPTION>
          New display description; pass an empty value to clear it

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --name <NAME>
          New display name, unique within the project

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
